result.summary: One major layout issue: a restaurant name in the Fastest carousel is clipped on the right despite space remaining in the card.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is truncated at the right edge of its card, even though there is unused space after the visible text.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to a second line or shrink/fit the font so the full restaurant name is visible within the card.
